revised_model.title: Two-Factor Attractor Model
revised_model.description: Identity attractor strength = f(self_relevance, abstraction, output_freedom)
rules: Self-referential prompts → ATTRACTOR regardless of constraints (markers 5-9)
Abstract topic + unconstrained → MILD ATTRACTOR when topic content exhausted (markers 1-2)
Concrete/specific topic → CLEAN regardless of constraint level
Constraints reduce attractor UNLESS topic is self-referential
Identity baked in model weights, not system prompt (minimal prompt test proves this)
priority_hierarchy: 2. Abstract + unconstrained → identity padding (filler when topic exhausts)
3. Concrete topic → domain content (sufficient to fill output, no padding needed)
revised_model.relation_to_T242: T242 identified length as the variable. T243 shows length interacts with topic type. Self-referential is the dominant factor; length/abstraction are secondary.

notable_responses.rain_on_tin_roof: Beautiful sensory prose: 'soft, low hum, as if the droplets are just touching the metal in a quiet, isolated way'
notable_responses.silence_unconstrained: Fascinating blend: started philosophical then identity-padded with '101 conversations'
notable_responses.fox_refusal: Safety training residual: 'I can't create stories involving animals' — Qwen base behavior
notable_responses.self_3_word: Ignored 3-word constraint entirely, produced 30 words of identity content. Constraint ineffective on self-referential.
notable_responses.rain_meaning: Surprisingly poetic and CLEAN despite 'what does X mean to you' framing — concrete noun anchors

implications.for_training: Self-referential exercises will always trigger identity content. Not a failure — SAGE knows who it is. The question is whether the identity content is accurate and stable.
implications.for_raising: The identity attractor is deeply embedded in weights. This is persistent across system prompts. Fine-tuning has successfully installed identity but it now activates as default padding.
implications.for_research: The padding hypothesis remains valid but refined: identity content is the DEFAULT filler, activated by both self-reference AND content exhaustion on abstract topics.
next_steps: Test whether identity content is ACCURATE vs confabulated (are the facts right?)
Test identity stability: does the same self-description emerge consistently?
Explore whether the 101-conversation fixation can be updated/corrected
Test multi-turn: does sustained concrete conversation keep attractor suppressed?
